Checklist Item: No inline scripts without nonce/hash (CSP compliant)
External scripts use Subresource Integrity (SRI) where applicable
No unsanitized user input in innerHTML or dangerous sinks
Unsafe innerHTML usage within threshold (zero or flagged)
No hardcoded API keys or secrets in source
No credentials or tokens in URLs or query parameters
No sensitive data in client-side comments or console logs
No insecure storage usage (localStorage/sessionStorage for secrets)
No PII stored in cookies or browser storage without encryption or consent
No known vulnerable dependencies (npm audit / Snyk)
Outdated dependencies reviewed for security advisories
Sensitive form fields have appropriate autocomplete attributes
No sensitive data exposed in client-visible IDs or data attributes
